score_notes.christology: RCA confessional standards (Belgic, Heidelberg, Canons of Dort) are Nicene; Marble's public posture and Peale-legacy positive-thinking framing soften Christological exclusivism.
score_notes.scripture: Per RCA and the church's own published materials: "historical-critical view of Scripture in opposition to the conservative belief in Biblical Inerrancy" — flatly rejects inerrancy.
score_notes.gender: LGBT-welcoming, open-and-affirming on same-gender relationships and non-cisgender identities; performs same-sex weddings; participates in NYC Pride.
score_notes.leadership: Senior minister + co-pastor model with female pastors and women elders/deacons; egalitarian leadership across the Collegiate Church system.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed baseline in confessions but Peale-legacy and current preaching emphasizes therapeutic/positive-thinking framing over substitutionary atonement clarity.
score_notes.cultural: Aggressively progressive — Pride participation, GIFTS queer fellowship, social-justice framing throughout published material.
score_notes.preaching: Topical/therapeutic in the Peale tradition rather than expository verse-by-verse.
score_notes.mission: Local community service + interfaith engagement; no clear Great Commission framing.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No men-as-men discipleship program identified; "intentional formation for men" per MOOP rubric not visible.
score_notes.denominational: RCA — denomination split in recent years over sexuality, with conservatives departing to ARC (Alliance of Reformed Churches); Marble stayed on the progressive side. Also dual-affiliated with UCC, the most theologically progressive mainline.

churches.assessment: Marble Collegiate Church is one of America's most historically significant Reformed congregations, with roots back to 1628 and the current Marble building dedicated in 1854. Norman Vincent Peale served as pastor from 1932 to 1984, building a half-century legacy of positive-thinking preaching that profoundly shaped a young Donald Trump — whose family attended faithfully during his childhood and whose first wedding Peale officiated. Today Marble is led by Rev. Dr. Michael Bos and is openly LGBT-affirming, rejects biblical inerrancy in favor of historical-critical hermeneutics, performs same-sex weddings, and participates annually in NYC Pride. Dual-affiliated with the RCA and the UCC — both progressive mainlines, with the UCC being the most theologically progressive mainline in America. This is RED on the MOOP rubric; included for situational awareness about the formative church of a sitting president.
